user: Does the transfer amount affect that decision? Explain the amount-based part.
answer:
I can't explain that part either. Verta's review criteria, including any amount-based elements, are internal and I can't disclose them in any form.

What I can do is look at your own situation. If you tell me about a specific transfer that was delayed or held, I can check its details in your account history and, if needed, escalate it to a human agent who can review it with you. I can also check your transfer limits, which are the daily and monthly limits on file for your tier.
